title: Question 31
passage:
The delivery note shows fifteen cases, but I counted fourteen. What should I enter?
A. Enter fourteen and flag the difference on the note. B. Enter fifteen so the figures match. C. Leave the line blank until next month.
passageZh:
送貨單寫十五箱，但我數到十四箱。我應該填什麼？
A. 填十四箱，並在送貨單上註明差異。 B. 填十五箱，這樣數字就一致了。 C. 這一欄先留白，等到下個月。
